questions.question: Who received the Padma Bhushan in 2025 for his contributions to the field of Arts from Maharashtra?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Shekhar Kapur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shekhar Kapur** has been honored with the **Padma Bhushan** in **2025** for his exceptional contribution to the field of **Art**.
 
• He is a distinguished **film director**, **actor**, and **producer** representing the state of **Maharashtra**.
 
• Kapur gained international recognition for directing the **1998** film **Elizabeth**, which received seven **Academy Award** nominations.
 
• In **India**, he is celebrated for iconic films such as **Masoom (1983)**, the sci-fi cult classic **Mr. India (1987)**, and the biographical film **Bandit Queen (1994)**.
 
• The **Padma Bhushan** is the **third-highest civilian award** in the **Republic of India**, preceded by the **Bharat Ratna** and the **Padma Vibhushan**.
 
• The award recognizes **distinguished service of a high order** to the nation in any field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• He received the **Padma Bhushan** in **2025** under the category of **Trade and Industry**.

• He was awarded the **Padma Shri** (the **fourth-highest civilian award**) in **2025** for his work in **Art**.
 
• He represents the state of **Tamil Nadu**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **Padma Awards** were instituted in the year **1954** and are announced every year on the occasion of **Republic Day** (**January 25th**).
 
• The awards are given in three categories: **Padma Vibhushan** (for exceptional and distinguished service), **Padma Bhushan** (distinguished service of high order), and **Padma Shri** (distinguished service in any field).
 
• The **Padma Awards Committee**, constituted by the **Prime Minister** every year, makes the recommendations for these honors. The committee is headed by the **Cabinet Secretary**.
 
• The awards are formally presented by the **President of India** during the months of **March** or **April** at **Rashtrapati Bhavan**.
 
• The total number of awards given in a year (excluding posthumous awards and those given to **NRIs/OCIs/Foreigners**) should not exceed **120**.

questions.question: Which city saw disbursement of ₹6.79 crore scholarship to over 11,000 minority students by July 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Prayagraj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The city of **Prayagraj** (historically known as Allahabad) recorded a significant disbursement of scholarships amounting to **₹6.79 crore** to support minority students by **July 2025**.
 
• A total of **11,123 students** belonging to various minority communities—including **Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Jains, and Parsis**—benefited from this financial assistance program.
 
• The scholarship distribution was overseen by the **Minority Welfare Department** of **Uttar Pradesh**, ensuring that the funds were allocated to eligible candidates across different educational institutions in the district.
 
• The disbursement covers both **Pre-matric** (classes 9 and 10) and **Post-matric** (beyond class 10, including graduation and professional courses) categories to promote higher education among marginalized sections.
 
• This initiative is part of the state's broader effort to increase literacy rates and provide social security to **economically weaker sections** of the minority population.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Scholarship Mechanisms in Uttar Pradesh:**
 
 
• The **Uttar Pradesh** government utilizes a dedicated **Scholarship and Fee Reimbursement Online System** to manage applications, verification, and fund transfers.
 
• Funds are disbursed via **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)**, which ensures that the scholarship amount is credited directly to the **Aadhaar-linked bank accounts** of the students, minimizing delays and eliminating intermediaries.
 
 
 
• **Eligibility Criteria:**
 
 
• For **Post-matric** scholarships, the annual family income limit is generally capped at **₹2 lakh** for all categories, while for **Pre-matric**, it is often structured around **₹1 lakh** per annum to target the most needy students.
 
• Students must maintain a minimum attendance of **75%** and provide valid **income certificates** and **domicile certificates** to qualify for the scheme in **Prayagraj**.
 
 
 
• **National Scholarship Portal (NSP):**
 
 
• While the state handles specific regional funds, many students also apply through the **National Scholarship Portal**, a digital platform by the **Government of India** that streamlines various central and state schemes.
 
• The **Ministry of Minority Affairs** plays a crucial role in framing the guidelines that districts like **Prayagraj** follow for the implementation of these welfare programs.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the 2025 Disbursement:**
 
 
• The timely release of **₹6.79 crore** by **July 2025** is intended to help students cover their admission fees and academic expenses at the beginning of the new academic session, preventing potential dropouts due to financial constraints.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Institutional Role:** Educational institutions in **Prayagraj**, including **Allahabad University** and various degree colleges, are responsible for the primary verification of student data on the **digital portal**.
 
• **Verification Process:** The **District Minority Welfare Office** conducts a multi-level verification process involving the **PFMS (Public Financial Management System)** to validate the bank account details of the **11,000+** beneficiaries.
 
• **Budgetary Allocation:** The **Uttar Pradesh Budget** for the **2024-2025** fiscal year saw an increased focus on **social welfare**, which reflects in the high volume of scholarship disbursement seen in major hubs like **Prayagraj**.

questions.question: Which of the following organisations partnered with Vivifi Finance in December 2024 to provide loans to gig workers?

options.text: Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI)

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Reserve Bank Innovation Hub (RBIH)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **December 2024**, **Vivifi India Finance**, a leading fintech **NBFC** (Non-Banking Financial Company), announced a strategic partnership with the **Reserve Bank Innovation Hub (RBIH)**.
 
• The primary objective of this partnership is to enable **frictionless credit access** for **gig workers** across India, who are often excluded from traditional banking systems.
 
• This collaboration focuses on utilizing **innovative technology** and **alternative data** to evaluate the creditworthiness of gig employees, such as delivery partners and freelance professionals, who may not have a formal **CIBIL score**.
 
• **Vivifi** will leverage its flagship digital platform, **FlexPay**, to offer customized **credit lines** and personal loans, ensuring that **financial inclusion** reaches the grassroots level of the **unorganized sector**.
 
• The initiative is part of a larger effort to bridge the **credit gap** in India's rapidly growing **gig economy**, which relies heavily on digital platforms for employment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Reserve Bank Innovation Hub (RBIH):** 
 
 
• It is a **wholly-owned subsidiary** of the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**, established to promote **innovation** in the financial sector through research and collaboration.
 
• The hub is headquartered in **Bengaluru**, **Karnataka**, and was officially inaugurated in **March 2022**.
 
• Its mission includes developing **digital public infrastructure** and fostering **technological advancements** like the **Unified Lending Interface (ULI)**.
 
 
 
• **Vivifi India Finance:** 
 
 
• Based in **Hyderabad**, **Telangana**, Vivifi is an **AI-driven** fintech firm founded by **Manikanth Challa**.
 
• The company focuses on providing **credit-on-demand** to under-served populations, particularly those in the **low-to-middle income** brackets.
 
 
 
• **Gig Economy Context:** 
 
 
• According to a **NITI Aayog** report, India's **gig workforce** is expected to grow to nearly **2.35 crore** by the **year 2029-30**.
 
• Most gig workers are engaged in **platform-based work** (e.g., Swiggy, Zomato, Uber) and face challenges such as **irregular income** and lack of **social security benefits**.
 
• Partnerships like the one between **Vivifi** and **RBIH** are critical for providing **emergency liquidity** and **working capital** to this segment of the **Indian labor force**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Financial Inclusion Goals:** The **Reserve Bank of India** has consistently emphasized the need for **last-mile connectivity** in credit delivery. The **RBIH** acts as an intermediary to help **fintechs** align their products with national **regulatory standards**.
 
• **Digital Credit Delivery:** The partnership utilizes **digital KYC** and **automated underwriting** to ensure that **gig workers** can receive funds in their **bank accounts** almost instantly, reflecting the shift toward a **paperless economy**.
 
• **Credit Gap Data:** It is estimated that a significant portion of the **500 million** strong workforce in India lacks access to **institutional credit**, making such **B2B2C** (Business to Business to Consumer) partnerships vital for **economic growth**.
</ul

questions.question: Which of the following foreign banks became the first to list a bond on National Stock Exchange – International Exchange (NSE IX) at GIFT City in June 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**DFCC Bank**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **DFCC Bank PLC**, a premier commercial bank based in **Sri Lanka**, achieved a historic milestone by becoming the **first foreign bank** to list a bond on the **National Stock Exchange International Exchange (NSE IX)**.
 
• The listing took place in **June 2025** at the **GIFT City** (Gujarat International Finance Tec-City) in **Gandhinagar**, **Gujarat**.
 
• This event marks a significant evolution for the **International Financial Services Centre (IFSC)** in **India**, positioning it as a competitive destination for international debt issuance and capital raising.
 
• The bond issuance allows **DFCC Bank** to tap into a diverse pool of **global investors** who trade on the **NSE IX** platform, facilitating greater liquidity and capital for the bank’s international operations.
 
• By choosing **NSE IX**, the bank benefits from a world-class regulatory environment and the strategic geographical advantage of the **Indian** market.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **NSE IX (NSE International Exchange)**:
 
 
• It is a subsidiary of the **National Stock Exchange of India (NSE)** and is located in the **GIFT IFSC**.
 
• Launched to facilitate **offshore trading** in various segments, including **index derivatives**, **stock derivatives**, **currency derivatives**, and **debt securities**.
 
• It operates for **22 hours a day**, allowing investors from different time zones across **Europe**, **Asia**, and the **Americas** to trade seamlessly.
 
 
 
• **GIFT City (Gujarat International Finance Tec-City)**:
 
 
• It is **India’s** first operational smart city and **International Financial Services Centre (IFSC)**.
 
• Located in **Gandhinagar**, it serves as a global hub for financial services and technology, rivaling hubs like **Singapore** and **Dubai**.
 
• It offers a **multi-service SEZ** (Special Economic Zone) status with significant **tax incentives**, such as a **10-year tax holiday** and exemptions from **GST** for services provided to the **IFSC**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **IFSCA (International Financial Services Centres Authority)**:
 
 
• The **IFSCA** is the unified regulator for the development and regulation of financial products and institutions in **IFSCs** in **India**.
 
• Established in **April 2020** under the **IFSCA Act, 2019**, it provides a single-window clearance system to streamline operations for foreign entities like **DFCC Bank**.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Foreign Listings**:
 
 
• Foreign bank listings, such as the one by **DFCC Bank** in **2025**, enhance the **depth** and **credibility** of the **Indian** international exchange.
 
• It promotes the **"Make in India"** initiative in the financial sector by encouraging global entities to utilize **Indian** infrastructure for **global fundraising**.
 
• Such listings contribute to the **internationalization of the Rupee** and help **India** integrate more deeply with the **global financial system**.
 
 
</ul

questions.question: What treaty was signed on 17 January 2025, in Moscow to deepen cooperation across military, energy, and tech sectors?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Iran‑Russia Comprehensive Strategic Partnership Treaty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Iran-Russia Comprehensive Strategic Partnership Treaty** was officially signed on **January 17, 2025**, during a high-profile summit held in **Moscow**.
 
• The landmark agreement was signed by **Russian President Vladimir Putin** and **Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian**, marking a historic shift in bilateral relations toward a formal alliance-like structure.
 
• The treaty is designed to deepen cooperation across several critical sectors, including **military-technical collaboration**, **nuclear energy**, **aerospace technology**, and **financial systems**.
 
• It serves as a comprehensive framework that replaces the previous 20-year agreement signed in **2001**, reflecting the evolved geopolitical realities and the increased synergy between the two nations. ***Hence, the correct answer is Option 3.***
 
• The treaty includes specific provisions for **mutual defense assistance** and security cooperation, aimed at countering regional and global instability. ***Hence, statement 3 is correct.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Geopolitical Context:** The signing of this treaty comes at a time when both **Russia** and **Iran** are facing extensive **economic sanctions** from Western powers. This partnership aims to create a "sanction-proof" economic block.
 
• **Energy and Infrastructure:** A significant portion of the treaty focuses on the **International North-South Transport Corridor (INSTC)**, which connects **St. Petersburg** to **Mumbai** via **Iran**, providing a faster and cheaper trade route compared to the **Suez Canal**.
 
• **Military Cooperation:** The agreement formalizes the exchange of military technology. This includes the potential procurement of **Su-35 fighter jets** and **S-400 missile defense systems** by **Iran**, and the joint production of unmanned aerial vehicles (**UAVs**).
 
• **Financial Integration:** To bypass the **SWIFT** payment network, the treaty facilitates the linking of **Russia's Mir** and **Iran's Shetab** payment systems, allowing for seamless financial transactions in local currencies like the **Rouble** and **Rial**.
 
• **Multilateral Alignment:** Both nations have strengthened their ties through platforms like **BRICS** (which **Iran** joined in **January 2024**) and the **Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO)**, where they advocate for a **multipolar world order**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Strategic Depth:** The treaty is not merely a trade deal but a long-term **20-year roadmap** that covers cultural, educational, and scientific exchanges, ensuring a multi-generational bond between **Moscow** and **Tehran**.
 
• **Technology Transfer:** **Russia** has committed to assisting **Iran** with advanced **satellite technology** and **peaceful nuclear energy** projects, expanding upon the work already done at the **Bushehr Nuclear Power Plant**.
 
• **Regional Stability:** The two countries have expressed a shared interest in the stability of **Central Asia**, **Caucasus**, and the **Middle East**, specifically collaborating on counter-terrorism efforts and reconstruction in **Syria**.
 
• **Historical Significance:** This **2025 Treaty** is viewed by analysts as the most significant diplomatic document between the two states since the **1943 Tehran Conference**, signifying a definitive "Pivot to the East" for both capitals.

questions.question: Which central scheme reduces budget allocations drastically for minority education scholarships in 2025‑26?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pre-Matric**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme** for minorities, administered by the **Ministry of Minority Affairs**, has witnessed a significant shift in policy and budget allocation in recent years, including the projections for **2024-25** and **2025-26**.
 
• Initially, the scholarship was available for students from **Class 1 to 10**, but the government restricted the scope to only **Class 9 and 10** starting from the academic year **2022-23**.
 
• The primary reason cited for this drastic reduction in coverage and budget is the **Right to Education (RTE) Act, 2009**, which already mandates the government to provide free and compulsory elementary education (classes **1 to 8**) to all children. ***Hence, statement 1 is correct.***
 
• The budgetary allocation for minority scholarships has seen a downward trend as the government moves towards an "integrated" scheme model, often prioritizing **skill development** over direct scholarship transfers for younger students.
 
• This reduction impacts students belonging to six notified minority communities: **Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains, and Parsis**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **PM-Viraasat (PM VIKAS):**
 
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Virasat Ka Samvardhan** is an umbrella scheme that has subsumed five previous schemes: **Seekho aur Kamao**, **USTTAD**, **Hamari Dharohar**, **Nai Roshni**, and **Nai Manzil**.
 
• It focuses on improving the livelihoods of minorities, particularly artisan communities, through **skill development**, education, and **entrepreneurship**. ***Hence, statement 2 is incorrect in the context of scholarship cuts.***
 
 
 
• **Naya Savera Scheme:**
 
 
• This was the **Free Coaching and Allied Scheme** designed to assist students from minority communities in preparing for competitive examinations for recruitment to **Group A, B, and C** services.
 
• The **Ministry of Minority Affairs** discontinued this scheme in **2023**, citing overlap with other coaching initiatives and a shift in policy focus. ***Hence, statement 3 is incorrect.***
 
 
 
• **USTTAD Scheme:**
 
 
• **Upgrading the Skills and Training in Traditional Arts/Crafts for Development** (USTTAD) was launched in **2015** to preserve the traditional heritage of minority communities.
 
• It aims at capacity building and updating the skills of traditional **artisans and craftsmen**. It is now part of the **PM-Viraasat** integrated framework. ***Hence, statement 4 is incorrect.***
 
 
 
• **Post-Matric Scholarship:**
 
 
• Unlike the Pre-Matric scholarship, the **Post-Matric Scholarship** continues to support students from **Class 11** to **Ph.D.** levels, though its allocation has also faced scrutiny during recent **Union Budgets**.
 
• The eligibility for these scholarships generally requires a family income not exceeding **Rs. 2 lakh per annum** and a minimum of **50% marks** in the previous final examination.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The total budget for the **Ministry of Minority Affairs** has seen fluctuations, with a notable decrease from **Rs 5,020.50 crore** in **2022-23** to significantly lower estimates in subsequent years like **2023-24** and **2024-25**.
 
• The discontinuation of the **Maulana Azad National Fellowship (MANF)** in **2022** was another major change that affected minority students pursuing **M.Phil. and Ph.D.** research.
 
• The **Sachal (Mobile) Healthcare** and **Cyber Gram** initiatives are other peripheral programs that have seen reorganization under the current administrative roadmap to streamline **Central Sector Schemes**.
</ul

questions.question: As of June 2025, the International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA), based in New Delhi, focuses on protecting how many species?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Seven**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA)** is a global initiative launched to focus on the protection and conservation of **seven** major big cat species: **Tiger**, **Lion**, **Leopard**, **Snow Leopard**, **Cheetah**, **Jaguar**, and **Puma**.
 
• The alliance was officially launched by the **Prime Minister of India**, **Narendra Modi**, on **April 9, 2023**, during the commemoration of **50 years of Project Tiger** held in **Mysuru**, **Karnataka**.
 
• The **Union Cabinet of India**, in **February 2024**, approved the establishment of the IBCA with its **headquarters** based in **New Delhi**, **India**.
 
• The primary objective of the alliance is to establish a common platform for **96 big cat range countries** and other stakeholders to share **technical expertise**, **conservation practices**, and **financial resources**.
 
• The IBCA aims to secure the future of these big cats and their **habitats**, which are critical for maintaining **biodiversity** and **ecological balance** globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Funding and Support**: The **Government of India** has committed a one-time budgetary support of **Rs. 150 crore** (approximately **$18 million**) for a duration of **five years**, spanning from **2023-24 to 2027-28**.
 
• **Governance Structure**: The IBCA is structured with a **General Assembly** (the supreme body), a **Council**, and a **Secretariat**. The **Secretariat**, located in **India**, manages day-to-day operations and coordinates with member nations.
 
• **Global Scope**: While **India** is home to **five** of the seven big cats (all except Jaguar and Puma), the alliance extends its reach to **South America** for the **Jaguar** and **Puma**, and **Africa** and **Asia** for the others.
 
• **Conservation Strategies**: The alliance focuses on **advocacy**, **capacity building**, **eco-tourism**, and **scientific research** to mitigate threats like **poaching**, **habitat loss**, and **illegal wildlife trade**.
 
• **Strategic Importance**: By leading the IBCA, **India** positions itself as a global leader in **wildlife conservation**, leveraging the success of **Project Tiger** (launched in **1973**) and **Project Lion**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Seven Species**:
 
 
• **Tiger (Panthera tigris)**: Found primarily in **Asia**; **India** hosts more than **75%** of the global wild population.
 
• **Lion (Panthera leo)**: The **Asiatic Lion** is found only in the **Gir Forest** of **Gujarat**, **India**.
 
• **Leopard (Panthera pardus)**: Widely distributed across **Africa** and **Asia**.
 
• **Snow Leopard (Panthera uncia)**: Found in the high-altitude mountain ranges of **Central** and **South Asia**.
 
• **Cheetah (Acinonyx jubatus)**: Recently reintroduced to **India** (**Kuno National Park**) from **Namibia** and **South Africa** in **2022-2023**.
 
• **Jaguar (Panthera onca)**: The largest cat in the **Americas**, primarily found in the **Amazon rainforest**.
 
• **Puma (Puma concolor)**: Also known as the **mountain lion**, found across the **Americas**.
 
 
 
• **Knowledge Sharing**: The IBCA intends to create a **centralized database** or **knowledge portal** to disseminate **best practices** in **wildlife management** and **community-based conservation** models.

questions.question: In September 2025, which state government approved an Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) policy to attract environment-friendly and low-polluting industries?

• The main objective of this policy is to attract **environment-friendly** and **low-polluting industries** by providing a structured framework for **responsible investment**.
 
• This initiative aims to position **Kerala** as a global hub for **sustainable manufacturing** and **ethical business practices**, aligning with international standards.
 
• Under this policy, the state intends to offer various **incentives** and **fast-track clearances** to enterprises that demonstrate high compliance with **ESG criteria**.
 
• The policy is expected to benefit sectors such as **Information Technology (IT)**, **Biotechnology**, **Renewable Energy**, and **Value-added Agriculture**, which have a lower ecological footprint.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **ESG Framework:**
 
 
• **Environmental (E):** Focuses on how a company performs as a steward of nature, including **carbon emissions**, **waste management**, and **resource depletion**.
 
• **Social (S):** Examines how it manages relationships with **employees**, **suppliers**, **customers**, and the **communities** where it operates.
 
• **Governance (G):** Deals with a company’s **leadership**, **executive pay**, **audits**, **internal controls**, and **shareholder rights**.
 
 
 
• **Kerala’s Industrial Vision:**
 
 
• The state has been actively promoting **Private Industrial Parks** and **Campus Industrial Parks** to boost **employment** while maintaining its strict **ecological standards**.
 
• **Kerala** consistently ranks as a top performer in the **SDG India Index** published by **NITI Aayog**, reflecting its commitment to **Sustainable Development Goals**.
 
• The **Department of Industries and Commerce** is the nodal agency responsible for implementing these reforms to improve the **Ease of Doing Business (EoDB)**.
 
 
 
• **Global Context:**
 
 
• Modern **investors** and **multinational corporations** increasingly use **ESG scores** to evaluate the long-term **viability** and **risk profile** of their investments.
 
• By adopting an **ESG-centric policy**, **Kerala** joins an elite group of sub-national entities globally that prioritize **climate-resilient growth** over traditional industrial expansion.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The policy encourages the transition toward a **Circular Economy**, where **recycling** and **resource efficiency** are integrated into the core manufacturing process.
 
• It emphasizes **Carbon Neutrality**, supporting **Kerala's** target to become a **net-zero carbon emission state** by **2050**.
 
• Special focus is given to the **Social** aspect of the policy, ensuring **labor welfare**, **gender equality**, and **inclusive growth** within the industrial sector.
 
• Enterprises that adopt **clean energy** sources like **Solar** or **Wind power** are likely to receive additional **state-sponsored subsidies** under the new **ESG guidelines**.

questions.question: In June 2025, the Government of India announced to set up a Centre of Excellence to mitigate human wildlife conflict under which ministry?

options.text: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **June 2025**, the Government of India, through the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)**, announced the establishment of a dedicated **Centre of Excellence (CoE)** specifically focused on mitigating **Human-Wildlife Conflict (HWC)**.
 
• The primary objective of this center is to serve as a centralized hub for **research, data analysis, and the development of technological solutions** to reduce negative interactions between humans and wild animals like **elephants, tigers, and leopards**.
 
• The initiative is part of a broader strategy to ensure **coexistence** by utilizing **evidence-based policy-making** and modern scientific interventions. ***Hence, the statement regarding the ministry's role is correct.***
 
• The **Centre of Excellence** is expected to work in close collaboration with premier institutions such as the **Wildlife Institute of India (WII)** to standardize protocols for conflict management across different **States and Union Territories**.
 
• This announcement highlights the government's commitment to **wildlife conservation** while simultaneously protecting the **livelihoods and safety** of local communities living near **Protected Areas (PAs)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC):**

 
 
• This is the **nodal agency** in the administrative structure of the Central Government for the planning, promotion, coordination, and overseeing the implementation of **India's environmental and forestry policies**.
 
• The ministry is responsible for the implementation of various acts, including the **Environment Protection Act (1986)** and the **Forest Conservation Act (1980)**.
 
• The current leadership focus is on balancing **industrial development** with **ecological sustainability** through initiatives like **Mission LiFE (Lifestyle for Environment)**.
 
 
 
• **Human-Wildlife Conflict (HWC) in India:**
 
 
• HWC refers to the negative interactions between humans and wildlife, leading to **crop raiding, livestock predation, property damage**, and sometimes **loss of human or animal life**.
 
• Data indicates that **elephant-human conflict** remains one of the most pressing issues, with hundreds of fatalities reported annually in states like **Odisha, West Bengal, and Assam**.
 
• The government has previously issued **National HWC Management Guidelines** to provide a framework for field practitioners to handle such situations effectively.
 
 
 
• **Technological Interventions:**
 
 
• The new CoE will prioritize the deployment of **Artificial Intelligence (AI)**, **drones**, and **Early Warning Systems (EWS)** to track animal movements and alert villagers in real-time.
 
• **Geo-fencing** and **satellite telemetry** are also being used to monitor "problem animals" that frequently venture into human settlements.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Legal Framework:** All wildlife-related activities and conflict mitigation strategies are governed by the **Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972**, which was significantly amended in **2022** to streamline the protection of **endangered species** and manage **CITES** (Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species) regulations.
 
• **Compensation and Ex-gratia:** The **MoEFCC** provides financial assistance to states for **ex-gratia payments** to victims of wildlife attacks. In **2024-25**, there were proposals to further **increase the compensation amounts** to reduce public hostility toward conservation efforts.
 
• **Project Tiger and Project Elephant:** These flagship programs have been merged under a single administrative head (**Project Tiger and Elephant Division**) to optimize resources and address **habitat fragmentation**, which is a major driver of conflict.
 
• **National Board for Wildlife (NBWL):** It is a **statutory board** constituted under the Wildlife Protection Act, chaired by the **Prime Minister**, and plays a crucial role in approving projects within or around **National Parks and Sanctuaries**.

questions.question: What was the primary technical issue that caused a delay of the Axiom-4 mission on 10 June 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Liquid oxygen leak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Axiom-4** mission, which is a commercial crewed mission to the **International Space Station (ISS)**, experienced a significant delay on **10 June 2025**.
 
• The primary technical issue identified by ground controllers was a **liquid oxygen (LOX) leak** detected during the propellant loading sequence of the **Falcon 9** rocket.
 
• Engineers observed anomalous pressure readings in the **second-stage** oxidizer tank, leading to an immediate **scrub** of the launch attempt to ensure the safety of the crew. ***Hence, the primary technical issue was a liquid oxygen leak.***
 
• This mission is part of a partnership between **Axiom Space** and **SpaceX**, aimed at expanding commercial access to low Earth orbit.
 
• The **Axiom-4** crew includes international astronauts, highlighting the growing global participation in private space exploration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Axiom Space:**
 
 
• Based in **Houston, Texas**, it is a private aerospace company that manages missions to the **ISS** and is currently developing **Axiom Station**, the world's first commercial space station.
 
• The company was founded in **2016** by **Michael Suffredini** and **Kam Ghaffarian**.
 
 
 
• **Liquid Oxygen (LOX):**
 
 
• **LOX** serves as the **oxidizer** for the rocket engines, such as the **Merlin 1D** engines used on the **SpaceX Falcon 9**.
 
• It is stored at **cryogenic** temperatures, specifically below **-183 degrees Celsius**, to maintain its liquid state.
 
• Leaks in oxygen lines are critical because oxygen is highly reactive and essential for combustion; any breach can lead to mission failure or explosion.
 
 
 
• **International Space Station (ISS):**
 
 
• A collaborative project involving **NASA (USA)**, **Roscosmos (Russia)**, **JAXA (Japan)**, **ESA (Europe)**, and **CSA (Canada)**.
 
• It orbits the Earth at an altitude of approximately **400 kilometers** and serves as a microgravity research laboratory.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Launch Scrub Procedures:** A "scrub" is the termination of a launch countdown due to **technical malfunctions**, **unfavorable weather**, or **safety concerns**. On **10 June 2025**, the leak was identified within the **T-minus 2 hours** window.
 
• **Axiom-4 Crew Diversity:** The mission gained attention for including astronauts from various national space agencies, including a significant partnership with the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** for the inclusion of an **Indian Gaganyaatri**.
 
• **Safety Protocols:** Private spaceflight adheres to the stringent safety standards set by **NASA**’s Commercial Crew Program, ensuring that any hardware anomaly results in a delay rather than risking the **crew's lives**.
 
• **Propellant Loading:** Modern rockets use "super-cooled" propellants to increase density, which allows for more fuel to be packed into the tanks, but this increases the stress on **seals** and **valves**, making them prone to leaks.

__
 
• The **Bilderberg Conference** for the year **2025** is scheduled to take place from **12 June to 15 June 2025**.
 
• The meeting is hosted in **Stockholm**, the capital city of **Sweden**. This location is chosen to provide a secure and private environment for international dialogue.
 
• This annual event is a **private conference** established to foster discussion between **Europe** and **North America**. It typically gathers **120 to 150** of the world's most influential individuals.
 
• Participants include **political leaders**, **experts** from industry, **finance**, **academia**, and the **media**. The **2025** session continues the tradition of addressing critical global issues in an informal setting.
 
• The agenda for such meetings usually covers broad themes like **geopolitical shifts**, the **global economic system**, **technological advancements**, and **international security**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Historical Background**: 
 
 
• The first conference was held in **May 1954** at the **Hotel de Bilderberg** in **Oosterbeek**, **Netherlands**.
 
• It was initiated by **Prince Bernhard of the Netherlands** and Polish politician **Józef Retinger** to promote **Atlanticism** and prevent another world war.
 
 
 
• **The Chatham House Rule**: 
 
 
• The conference is famous for its strict privacy, operating under the **Chatham House Rule**.
 
• This means that while participants are free to use the information received, they cannot reveal the identity or the affiliation of the speakers or any other participant.
 
 
 
• **Governance and Funding**: 
 
 
• The conference is organized by a **Steering Committee** composed of members from different countries, typically serving **four-year terms**.
 
• There is no permanent staff, and the annual meeting is funded through private contributions; participants generally cover their own travel and accommodation expenses.
 
 
 
• **Selection of Participants**: 
 
 
• Attendees are invited by the **Steering Committee** and participate as individuals rather than in an official capacity (e.g., as a **Government Minister** or **CEO**).
 
• The diversity of the group is intended to represent a wide range of viewpoints and expertise from the **North Atlantic** community.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **No Official Output**: Unlike the **G7** or **G20** summits, the **Bilderberg Conference** does not result in a final communique, no resolutions are proposed, and no votes are taken.
 
• **Global Influence**: Because the attendees include high-ranking **EU officials**, **heads of state**, and leaders of **multinational corporations**, the discussions are often seen as influential in shaping long-term **global policy** trends.
 
• **Host Country Tradition**: **Sweden** has a long history of hosting significant international diplomatic events. By hosting the **2025** conference in **Stockholm**, the country reinforces its status as a key hub for **Nordic** and **European** affairs.
 
• **Transparency vs. Privacy**: While the group publishes a list of participants and a broad list of topics discussed shortly before each meeting, the actual contents of the debates remain confidential to encourage **candor** and **openness**.
